comparison.objective: Slide a trapped acrylic panel along two extrusion slots to an end stop; the candidate adjusts a threaded stop and locks it.
comparison.physical_skill: One-arm constrained sliding while avoiding cocking and binding, not concentric two-tool countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Panel reaches the stop, is released, still, and stable for 1 s; candidate instead grades angular accuracy, nut retention, repeated motion, and drift.
comparison.reason: A linear guided slide does not test preserving an adjustment while tightening a jam nut.
